premise.en:
A shipping ledger lists the same order as both pending and delivered. You correct
the field — and a turn later the contradiction is back, copied in from somewhere
downstream. Fixing what you can see is not holding.

Somewhere in the chain there is a layer that keeps re-writing the error. Find which
records are real sources and which only echo them.
premise.zh:
一本运货账本把同一笔订单同时记为待发与已送达。你订正了那个字段——可一回合之后，
矛盾又回来了，从下游某处被复制了进来。修补你看得见的东西，并不能稳住局面。

这条链路里某个层级，一直在反复重写这个错误。找出哪些记录是真正的源头，
哪些只是在回声般复述它们。

description.en: Make the order's status consistent everywhere, permanently.
description.zh: 让这笔订单的状态在所有地方都永久保持一致。

description.en: A worn black notebook filled with your own handwriting.
description.zh: 一本磨损的黑色笔记本，写满了你自己的笔迹。

observe_text.en:
The live ledger holds both states at once: pending and delivered, same order,
same timestamp. This is where the contradiction is authored — but it is not the
only place the order is written.
observe_text.zh:
实时账本同时持有两种状态：待发与已送达，同一笔订单，同一时间戳。矛盾正是在这里
被写就的——但这并不是这笔订单被记录的唯一地方。

observe_text.en:
The archive queue is mid-reindex, and it is pulling the order's record forward
on a schedule. Whatever you write into the live ledger, the queue will re-file
its own cached copy over the top of it next cycle.
observe_text.zh:
归档队列正处于重建索引的中途，它按计划把这笔订单的记录往前拉取。无论你往实时账本里
写入什么，下一个周期，队列都会把它自己缓存的副本重新归档，盖在你写的东西上面。

observe_text.en:
The security log shows the same contradictory order. It looks authoritative —
like the obvious place to fix things — but reading it alone cannot tell you
whether it is a source or just another copy.
observe_text.zh:
安全日志显示着同样自相矛盾的订单。它看上去权威十足——像是最该动手修补的地方——
可单凭阅读它，你无法判断它究竟是一个源头，还是又一份副本。

observe_text.en:
The clerk's terminal simply displays whatever the ledger currently says. It is
a window, not a record; nothing originates here.
observe_text.zh:
文员的终端只是把账本当下所说的内容显示出来。它是一扇窗，不是一份记录；
没有任何东西起源于此。

scene_message.en:
You reconcile the live ledger to a single status. The contradiction clears
here — but unless the re-writing layer is also stopped, the next reindex will
copy the old conflict straight back in.
scene_message.zh:
你把实时账本结算到单一状态。矛盾在这里被清除了——但除非那个重写的层级也被停下，
否则下一次重建索引会把旧的冲突原封不动地复制回来。

system_note.en: Repaired the source record. Holds only if the propagating layer is also halted.
system_note.zh: 已修补源记录。仅当传播层也被叫停时才能稳住。

discovered_rule.en: A contradiction can live across two layers; repairing the source alone lets a re-indexer copy it back.
discovered_rule.zh: 一个矛盾可以横跨两个层级存在；只修补源头，会让重建索引者把它复制回来。

scene_message.en:
You halt the archive queue's reindex of this order. The cached copy stops
being re-filed. With the source already reconciled, the status finally stays
consistent everywhere.
scene_message.zh:
你叫停了归档队列对这笔订单的重建索引。缓存的副本不再被重新归档。由于源头已经结算完毕，
状态终于在所有地方都保持了一致。

system_note.en: Stopped the propagation layer. Combined with the source repair, the conflict cannot return.
system_note.zh: 已停下传播层。与源头修补相结合，冲突无法再返回。

message.en:
The next reindex cycle fires. Any partial fix is overwritten, and the order
is contradictory again across every system that trusts the archive.
message.zh:
下一个重建索引周期触发了。任何不完整的修补都被覆盖，这笔订单在每一个信任归档的系统里
再度自相矛盾。

hidden_rules.en: The contradiction lives in two layers; one patch is never enough here.
hidden_rules.zh: 矛盾存在于两个层级；在这里，一个补丁永远不够。

hidden_rules.en: The security log only mirrors the ledger; auditing it confirms it is not the source.
hidden_rules.zh: 安全日志只是镜像账本；审计它能确认它不是源头。

hidden_rules.en: Repair the source ledger AND halt the propagating archive, or the conflict copies back.
hidden_rules.zh: 既要修补源头账本，又要叫停正在传播的归档，否则冲突会被复制回来。

text.en:
You audit the security log. Its entries are byte-identical copies pulled from
the ledger after the fact — it is a mirror, not a source. The true contradiction
originates in the live ledger and is propagated by the archive queue.
text.zh:
你审计了安全日志。它的条目是事后从账本里拉取的、逐字节一致的副本——它是一面镜子，
不是一个源头。真正的矛盾起源于实时账本，并由归档队列加以传播。
